market_view: Risk-on day in Europe with metals up on a US-China truce extension and crude down as the Iran risk premium comes out. Most moves are continuations already priced in by midday, with US CPI pending as a two-way risk for copper, gold and chips, so nothing offers a named catalyst with an expected move well above round-trip cost.
would_change_my_mind: A primary-source, name-specific event (e.g. a confirmed earnings beat, guidance raise or contract from a traded name, reported by Reuters/Bloomberg rather than an aggregator) with costs under about 1.1% would clear the bar.

oil_gas.catalyst: Oil Prices Fall Below $90 as Trump Signals Reduced Risk of New Iran Attacks - EnergyNow.com - 2026-11-09
oil_gas.reasoning: Crude is falling as the geopolitical premium is removed, a headwind for the sector; the RBC target raise on ENI.MI keeps Sector Perform and is not enough against falling crude.

gold_miners.catalyst: FTSE 100 Climbs as Miners Benefit from Higher Gold Prices - Global Banking & Finance Review - 2026-11-09
gold_miners.reasoning: This is a continuation of the gold-price story and a Barrick read-across, already reflected in the midday miners rally; entry cost about 1.65% each way needs a move above 3.3%, which this does not justify.

chips.catalyst: Infineon stock gains on 300-millimeter SiC milestone - ad-hoc-news.de - 2026-11-09
chips.reasoning: The only name-specific positive is from an aggregator treated as weak confirmation, while an unnamed BofA downgrade of three European chip stocks and the Nvidia CEO probe weigh on the group.

pharma.catalyst: FDA investigates Novartis gene therapy link to tumours in children - EMJ - 2026-11-09
pharma.reasoning: The Novartis item is a negative safety risk, and the Sanofi Q3 item is likely stale with the move already made and costs of 1.42% including French tax.

copper_uranium.catalyst: Copper Price Forecast: China's Tight Supply Lifts Prices Before US CPI - FXEmpire - 2026-11-09
copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper strength continues a known story, and US CPI could reverse it; the Rio Tinto $144m step is immaterial and from an aggregator.

handoff.what_changed: First run: flat everywhere with 1000 EUR cash and no orders. Crude fell about 3.6% as Trump ruled out new Iran strikes, while gold, copper and European indices rose on a US-China truce extension. US CPI is pending.

gold_miners.why: The gold rally is a continuation that is already priced in, and costs are high for UK names.

chips.why: Only aggregator-sourced positives, and an unnamed BofA downgrade plus the Nvidia CEO probe weigh on the group.

pharma.why: Novartis has an FDA safety probe and the Sanofi Q3 news looks stale.

copper_uranium.why: Copper strength is a continuation with CPI risk ahead; the Rio item is immaterial.
